_about: English text for the site. 书单.md stays the source of truth; this file only translates it. Books are keyed by their key (the title without 《》 or a trailing bracketed note). scripts/check-booklist.mjs warns when a book has no English entry here.

01.name: Cognitive Sovereignty
01.question: How much of my attention, my values and my standards of judgment truly belongs to me?

02.name: Self and Inner Freedom
02.question: If I didn't have to live up to anyone's expectations, how would I spend this life?

03.name: Society and Human Nature
03.question: How much of the world I take for granted was built by society?

04.name: Philosophy and Meaning
04.question: If efficiency, achievement and wealth can't define a life, what can?

05.name: Literature and Emotional Depth
05.question: Do I really understand people, or can I only explain them with a few concepts?

06.name: Art and Aesthetics
06.question: Can I still truly see, hear and feel the world, rather than just recognize and consume it?

07.name: History and Civilization
07.question: Born in another age, country or class, would I still believe what I believe now?

08.name: Science and Worldview
08.question: Am I after the truth, or the explanation that makes me feel right?

09.name: Psychology and the Inner World
09.sub: Understand the machine that is you
09.question: Where do my emotions, my fears and the mistakes I keep repeating come from?

10.name: Wealth and Money
10.sub: Not ruled by money, not pretending to be above it
10.question: How much is enough? What do I want money to buy me?

11.name: Creation and Entrepreneurship
11.question: What do I want to add to the world? What risk am I willing to take for it?

第一年.name: Year 1
第一年.sub: Reclaim your attention, see yourself, see the world
第一年.intro: Six books a season, heavy and light in turn; Dream of the Red Chamber runs through the year, two chapters a week. If two books a month is too many, read only the first three of each season: those twelve are the core of the core.

第二年.name: Year 2
第二年.sub: Guard your attention, learn to love, think clearly about money, ask what you live for
第二年.intro: Year one took your attention back; year two spends it on daily life. Every season has a novel to keep the arguments honest.

第三年.name: Year 3
第三年.sub: Masks, origins, power, and the women who wrote back
第三年.intro: Digging on from Goffman and Fei Xiaotong in year one: how much of what you think you chose was handed to you by where you stand.

第四年.name: Year 4
第四年.sub: From the brain to the machine
第四年.intro: We talk to AI every day and rarely ask what understanding, consciousness and intelligence are. This year walks from psychology to neuroscience to machines.

第五年.name: Year 5
第五年.sub: Poetry, thought, everyday beauty, home and country
第五年.intro: Zhuangzi, Nine Poets and the Red Chamber opened the door in year one; this year walks in. Read the poems aloud and the history slowly.

第六年.name: Year 6
第六年.sub: How civilisations diverged, how money works, how things get made
第六年.intro: Reading ends in action. First the large scale of civilisation and money, then how one person makes a thing and makes it well.

第七年.name: Year 7
第七年.sub: Doubt, memory, becoming a person, and the highest peaks
第七年.intro: Six years of attention were saved up for this one. The last season holds the hardest, longest books in the library; slow is fine.

第一季.name: Season 1
第一季.theme: Breaking the ice: reclaim your attention

第三季.name: Season 3
第三季.theme: Seeing the world: structures, history and people

第四季.name: Season 4
第四季.theme: The deep dive: conversing with the greatest

第十季.name: Season 10
第十季.theme: Origins: how class is written into a person

第十二季.name: Season 12
第十二季.theme: Her: a room of one’s own

第二十二季.name: Season 22
第二十二季.theme: Turning an idea into a thing

groups.用一生慢慢读的: To read slowly over a lifetime

昨日的世界.title: The World of Yesterday
昨日的世界.author: Stefan Zweig
昨日的世界.note: Start with an author you already love. The man who wrote Letter from an Unknown Woman watches his civilized world collapse.

娱乐至死.title: Amusing Ourselves to Death
娱乐至死.author: Neil Postman
娱乐至死.note: Written about television in 1985; every sentence is about short video. The form of a medium decides what grade of truth we can think about.

观看之道.title: Ways of Seeing
观看之道.author: John Berger
观看之道.note: Thin, with lots of pictures. Afterwards, scrolling your feed you stop seeing stimuli and start seeing the logic pulling the strings.

如何阅读一本书.title: How to Read a Book
如何阅读一本书.author: Mortimer J. Adler / Charles Van Doren
如何阅读一本书.note: Sharpen the blade first. Analytical reading and syntopical reading are the method for every book after it.

倦怠社会.title: The Burnout Society
倦怠社会.author: Byung-Chul Han
倦怠社会.note: A hundred pages. Why the freer we are the more tired we get, and why we have lost the capacity for deep boredom.

我与地坛.title: The Temple of Earth and I
我与地坛.author: Shi Tiesheng
我与地坛.note: A high point of modern Chinese prose. How to live alongside fate and the limits of a life.

我的天才女友.title: My Brilliant Friend
我的天才女友.author: Elena Ferrante
我的天才女友.note: No. 1 on The New York Times list of the best books of the 21st century. Two girls, class, education, and the envy and love inside a friendship.

活出生命的意义.title: Man's Search for Meaning
活出生命的意义.author: Viktor E. Frankl
活出生命的意义.note: When everything else has been taken away, what is a person's last freedom?

悉达多.title: Siddhartha
悉达多.author: Hermann Hesse
悉达多.note: Wisdom can't be taught, even when the teacher is the Buddha. The most beautiful metaphor for refusing to outsource the answers to your life.

乡土中国.title: From the Soil
乡土中国.author: Fei Xiaotong
乡土中国.note: China's own Goffman. The phrase "differential mode of association" explains half of how social ties work in China.

悠悠岁月.title: The Years
悠悠岁月.author: Annie Ernaux
悠悠岁月.note: Personal memory written as sociology. Educated and Goffman meet here.

美的历程.title: The Path of Beauty
美的历程.author: Li Zehou
美的历程.note: From bronze-age taotie masks to Ming and Qing novels: the whole history of Chinese aesthetics in one breath.

不能承受的生命之轻.title: The Unbearable Lightness of Being
不能承受的生命之轻.author: Milan Kundera
不能承受的生命之轻.note: An anatomy of kitsch. Afterwards you are instinctively immune to cheap sentiment and polished performance.

社会学的想象力.title: The Sociological Imagination
社会学的想象力.author: C. Wright Mills
社会学的想象力.note: The ability to translate personal troubles into public issues. No. 2 on the International Sociological Association's books of the century.

国家的视角.title: Seeing Like a State
国家的视角.author: James C. Scott
国家的视角.note: How grand plans chasing legible metrics systematically destroy tacit knowledge. Read in the age of AI, it sends a chill down your spine.

安娜·卡列尼娜.title: Anna Karenina
安娜·卡列尼娜.author: Leo Tolstoy
安娜·卡列尼娜.note: The ceiling of the novel. Not one character is a device; everyone has their own reasons.

万历十五年.title: 1587, A Year of No Significance
万历十五年.author: Ray Huang
万历十五年.note: An uneventful year reveals the deadlock of a whole civilization.

艺术的故事.title: The Story of Art
艺术的故事.author: E. H. Gombrich
艺术的故事.note: "There really is no such thing as Art. There are only artists." Read it alongside trips to museums.

西西弗神话.title: The Myth of Sisyphus
西西弗神话.author: Albert Camus
西西弗神话.note: "There is but one truly serious philosophical problem." Follow it with The Stranger.

人的境况.title: The Human Condition
人的境况.author: Hannah Arendt
人的境况.note: Labor, work, action. When labor can be automated, what is left for us? She was asking in 1958.

卡拉马佐夫兄弟.title: The Brothers Karamazov
卡拉马佐夫兄弟.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
卡拉马佐夫兄弟.note: The anatomist of the soul Zweig revered most. Read "The Grand Inquisitor" three times.

庄子.title: Zhuangzi
庄子.author: Zhuangzi
庄子.note: The freest mind ever to write in Chinese. Start with the seven Inner Chapters.

九诗心.title: Nine Poets' Hearts
九诗心.author: Huang Xiaodan
九诗心.note: Douban's No. 1 book of 2025. How nine poets found peace in troubled times.

红楼梦.title: Dream of the Red Chamber
红楼梦.author: Cao Xueqin
红楼梦.note: The year of slow reading ends here. The sum of Chinese aesthetics.

升维阅读.title: Reader, Come Home
升维阅读.author: Maryanne Wolf
升维阅读.note: The book closest to why this project exists: a neuroscientist on the deep-reading circuit, which you either use or lose.

浅薄.title: The Shallows
浅薄.author: Nicholas Carr
浅薄.note: Written about the internet in 2010 and truer in the age of AI: what we outsource is not just memory but synthesis and judgment.

如何无所事事.title: How to Do Nothing
如何无所事事.author: Jenny Odell
如何无所事事.note: Resisting the attention economy. Why must every minute produce something?

论自由.title: On Liberty
论自由.author: John Stuart Mill
论自由.note: Why you must think for yourself and hear the other side yourself. Chapter 2 is the best argument.

反脆弱.title: Antifragile
反脆弱.author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
反脆弱.note: Contempt for outsourcing judgment to models and experts. Arrogant, long-winded, irreplaceable.

深度工作.title: Deep Work
深度工作.author: Cal Newport
深度工作.note: Practical. Treats focus as a scarce skill that needs training.

技术垄断.title: Technopoly
技术垄断.author: Neil Postman
技术垄断.note: The sequel to Amusing Ourselves to Death: when culture surrenders to technology.

人有人的用处.title: The Human Use of Human Beings
人有人的用处.author: Norbert Wiener
人有人的用处.note: The father of cybernetics was already asking in 1950: once machines take over, what should people do?

哥本哈根三部曲.title: The Copenhagen Trilogy
哥本哈根三部曲.author: Tove Ditlevsen
哥本哈根三部曲.note: A woman writes her way out of her origins, without it being packaged as an inspirational story: talent, desire and addiction all at once.

一间自己的房间.title: A Room of One's Own
一间自己的房间.author: Virginia Woolf
一间自己的房间.note: Money of your own and creative life. One lecture changed a century.

给青年诗人的信.title: Letters to a Young Poet
给青年诗人的信.author: Rainer Maria Rilke
给青年诗人的信.note: Ten letters on solitude, patience and how to live with the questions in your heart.

当呼吸化为空气.title: When Breath Becomes Air
当呼吸化为空气.author: Paul Kalanithi
当呼吸化为空气.note: Written by a neurosurgeon facing death at 36.

玻璃城堡.title: The Glass Castle
玻璃城堡.author: Jeannette Walls
玻璃城堡.note: The book most often mentioned with Educated: how to love parents who wrecked your childhood.

我是寨子里长大的女孩.title: A Girl Who Grew Up in the Mountain Village
我是寨子里长大的女孩.author: Zha Shiyire
我是寨子里长大的女孩.note: One of Douban's top ten books of 2025. China's own Educated, by a woman who left a mountain village in Yunnan.

秋园.title: Autumn Garden
秋园.author: Yang Benfen
秋园.note: An eighty-year-old daughter writes her mother's life at the kitchen table.

巨流河.title: The Great Flowing River
巨流河.author: Chi Pang-yuan
巨流河.note: One woman's life, one country's twentieth century.

爱的艺术.title: The Art of Loving
爱的艺术.author: Erich Fromm
爱的艺术.note: Love is a capacity you learn, not a matter of luck.

牧羊少年奇幻之旅.title: The Alchemist
牧羊少年奇幻之旅.author: Paulo Coelho
牧羊少年奇幻之旅.note: A fable: follow your own calling, and every stop on the road is part of the answer. For when you feel lost.

哲学家的最后一课.title: The Philosopher's Last Lesson
哲学家的最后一课.author: Zhu Rui
哲学家的最后一课.note: One of Douban's top ten books of 2025. A philosophy professor talks about death in the last ten days of his life.

Things in Nature Merely Grow.title: Things in Nature Merely Grow
Things in Nature Merely Grow.author: Yiyun Li
Things in Nature Merely Grow.note: 2026 Pulitzer Prize for Memoir. How to go on living after losing two sons. Deeply restrained, deeply heavy.

污名.title: Stigma
污名.author: Erving Goffman
污名.note: The next step after The Presentation of Self: how labeled people manage their identity.

区分：判断力的社会批判.title: Distinction: A Social Critique of the Judgement of Taste
区分：判断力的社会批判.author: Pierre Bourdieu
区分：判断力的社会批判.note: Is your taste really yours? Hard going, but it permanently changes how you see "taste".

现实的社会建构.title: The Social Construction of Reality
现实的社会建构.author: Peter L. Berger / Thomas Luckmann
现实的社会建构.note: How consensus becomes "reality". The theoretical foundation under Goffman.

规训与惩罚.title: Discipline and Punish
规训与惩罚.author: Michel Foucault
规训与惩罚.note: Power doesn't press down on you; it grows inside your body.

逃避自由.title: Escape from Freedom
逃避自由.author: Erich Fromm
逃避自由.note: Why people hand over their freedom willingly, which is exactly what this project is fighting.

第二性.title: The Second Sex
第二性.author: Simone de Beauvoir
第二性.note: "One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman."

不平等的童年.title: Unequal Childhoods
不平等的童年.author: Annette Lareau
不平等的童年.note: How class passes down through parenting. The academic flip side of Educated.

景观社会.title: The Society of the Spectacle
景观社会.author: Guy Debord
景观社会.note: Predicted social media feeds in 1967: life degraded into an appearance to be watched.

想象的共同体.title: Imagined Communities
想象的共同体.author: Benedict Anderson
想象的共同体.note: How print imagined the nation into being.

把自己作为方法.title: Self as Method
把自己作为方法.author: Xiang Biao / Wu Qi
把自己作为方法.note: A conversation, easy to read. On "the disappearance of the nearby".

沉思录.title: Meditations
沉思录.author: Marcus Aurelius
沉思录.note: A Roman emperor's notes to himself. Two pages every morning.

有限与无限的游戏.title: Finite and Infinite Games
有限与无限的游戏.author: James P. Carse
有限与无限的游戏.note: Playing to win versus playing to keep playing. Pulls your view out of comparison and the rat race.

苏格拉底的申辩.title: Apology
苏格拉底的申辩.author: Plato
苏格拉底的申辩.note: "The unexamined life is not worth living."

蒙田随笔.title: Essays
蒙田随笔.author: Michel de Montaigne
蒙田随笔.note: The first person to make "I" a subject of study. Open it anywhere; read it for life.

论语.title: The Analects
论语.author: Confucius
论语.note: Set aside the worn-out clichés and read the original.

中国哲学简史.title: A Short History of Chinese Philosophy
中国哲学简史.author: Fung Yu-lan
中国哲学简史.note: The best single map of Chinese thought.

存在主义咖啡馆.title: At the Existentialist Café
存在主义咖啡馆.author: Sarah Bakewell
存在主义咖啡馆.note: A group portrait of Sartre, Beauvoir and Camus. The most readable way into philosophy.

艾希曼在耶路撒冷.title: Eichmann in Jerusalem
艾希曼在耶路撒冷.author: Hannah Arendt
艾希曼在耶路撒冷.note: The banality of evil: not thinking is itself a kind of evil.

Meaning in Life and Why It Matters.title: Meaning in Life and Why It Matters
Meaning in Life and Why It Matters.author: Susan Wolf
Meaning in Life and Why It Matters.note: Contemporary analytic philosophy's answer: meaning is different from happiness, and different from morality.

尼各马可伦理学.title: Nicomachean Ethics
尼各马可伦理学.author: Aristotle
尼各马可伦理学.note: The first systematic answer to "what is happiness?"

瓦尔登湖.title: Walden
瓦尔登湖.author: Henry David Thoreau
瓦尔登湖.note: An experiment in how little a life really needs.

一个女人一生中的二十四小时象棋的故事.title: Twenty-Four Hours in the Life of a Woman / Chess Story
一个女人一生中的二十四小时象棋的故事.author: Stefan Zweig
一个女人一生中的二十四小时象棋的故事.note: Passion and losing control; and his last novella.

长日将尽.title: The Remains of the Day
长日将尽.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
长日将尽.note: A butler spends a lifetime of dignity avoiding a lifetime of feeling. Restrained to the point of heartbreak.

倾城之恋.title: Love in a Fallen City
倾城之恋.author: Eileen Chang
倾城之恋.note: Reality, desire and calculation inside love. The texture of Chinese prose.

情人.title: The Lover
情人.author: Marguerite Duras
情人.note: Its Chinese translation shaped a generation of Chinese writers.

斯通纳.title: Stoner
斯通纳.author: John Williams
斯通纳.note: Is an inner life no one sees worth living?

追忆似水年华第一卷.title: In Search of Lost Time, Vol. 1: Swann's Way
追忆似水年华第一卷.author: Marcel Proust
追忆似水年华第一卷.note: The ultimate training for attention, and its ultimate reward.

百年孤独.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
百年孤独.author: Gabriel García Márquez
百年孤独.note: It redrew the scale of the imagination.

魔山.title: The Magic Mountain
魔山.author: Thomas Mann
魔山.note: Seven years in a sanatorium; the great debate of European thought.

小径分岔的花园.title: The Garden of Forking Paths
小径分岔的花园.author: Jorge Luis Borges
小径分岔的花园.note: Ten pages a story, a labyrinth in each one.

惶然录.title: The Book of Disquiet
惶然录.author: Fernando Pessoa
惶然录.note: The unusually sharp inner world of a small office clerk. A few pages before bed.

瓦解.title: Things Fall Apart
瓦解.author: Chinua Achebe
瓦解.note: Tradition and colonialism seen from inside Africa. A step outside the single Western story.

战争与和平罪与罚.title: War and Peace / Crime and Punishment
战争与和平罪与罚.author: Leo Tolstoy / Fyodor Dostoevsky
战争与和平罪与罚.note: After Anna Karenina and The Brothers Karamazov.

达洛维夫人.title: Mrs Dalloway
达洛维夫人.author: Virginia Woolf
达洛维夫人.note: A single day's stream of consciousness.

洛丽塔.title: Lolita
洛丽塔.author: Vladimir Nabokov
洛丽塔.note: A conjuring trick with language, and a warning about being seduced by words.

呼兰河传.title: Tales of Hulan River
呼兰河传.author: Xiao Hong
呼兰河传.note: As lonely as it gets, as beautiful as it gets.

活着.title: To Live
活着.author: Yu Hua
活着.note: A Chinese novel that has sat near the top of Douban's ratings for years.

金阁寺.title: The Temple of the Golden Pavilion
金阁寺.author: Yukio Mishima
金阁寺.note: So beautiful it must be destroyed.

那不勒斯四部曲后三部.title: The Neapolitan Novels, Books 2–4
那不勒斯四部曲后三部.author: Elena Ferrante
那不勒斯四部曲后三部.note: For when you finish the first one and can't stop.

别让我走.title: Never Let Me Go
别让我走.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
别让我走.note: Do people who were made have souls? Rereading it in the age of AI hits differently.

2666.author: Roberto Bolaño
2666.note: Vast and dark; no one who finishes it forgets it.

基列家书.title: Gilead
基列家书.author: Marilynne Robinson
基列家书.note: An old minister's long letter to his young son. Quiet and holy.

素食者.title: The Vegetarian
素食者.author: Han Kang
素食者.note: Winner of the 2024 Nobel Prize in Literature.

撒旦探戈.title: Satantango
撒旦探戈.author: László Krasznahorkai
撒旦探戈.note: Winner of the 2025 Nobel Prize in Literature. Single sentences run for pages: a test of whether your attention has really come back.

看不见的城市.title: Invisible Cities
看不见的城市.author: Italo Calvino
看不见的城市.note: Fifty-five imaginary cities. Light and exact. Two or three pages before bed wash out the day's information junk.

阴翳礼赞.title: In Praise of Shadows
阴翳礼赞.author: Jun'ichirō Tanizaki
阴翳礼赞.note: In an age of oversaturated screens, learn again to love dimness, empty space and the patina of time.

反对阐释.title: Against Interpretation
反对阐释.author: Susan Sontag
反对阐释.note: Don't rush to explain everything as meaning. First recover your feel for the work itself.

美学散步.title: Strolls in Aesthetics
美学散步.author: Zong Baihua
美学散步.note: Chinese art and the spirit of life.

谈美.title: On Beauty
谈美.author: Zhu Guangqian
谈美.note: Fifteen letters to young people on beauty and everyday life.

人间词话.title: Poetic Remarks in the Human World
人间词话.author: Wang Guowei
人间词话.note: One idea: jingjie, the world a poem opens. Read it with Florence Chia-ying Yeh's commentary.

唐诗三百首+唐宋词十七讲.title: Three Hundred Tang Poems + Seventeen Lectures on Tang and Song Lyrics
唐诗三百首+唐宋词十七讲.author: Hengtang Tuishi / Florence Chia-ying Yeh
唐诗三百首+唐宋词十七讲.note: Learn one poem by heart each day. Taste is muscle memory.

诗的八堂课.title: Eight Lessons on Poetry
诗的八堂课.author: Jiang Ruoshui
诗的八堂课.note: Teaches you how to read poems, and is a pleasure to read in its own right.

万物静默如谜.title: View with a Grain of Sand (selected poems)
万物静默如谜.author: Wisława Szymborska
万物静默如谜.note: The most approachable modern poetry: light and deep.

红的自传.title: Autobiography of Red
红的自传.author: Anne Carson
红的自传.note: Winner of the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature. A Greek myth rewritten as a boy's heartbreak.

文学回忆录.title: Memoirs of Literature
文学回忆录.author: Mu Xin
文学回忆录.note: One man's history of world literature. Full of prejudices, impeccable taste.

陶庵梦忆.title: Dream Recollections of Tao'an
陶庵梦忆.author: Zhang Dai
陶庵梦忆.note: Late-Ming sketches: Chinese prose at its most exquisite.

中国艺术精神.title: The Spirit of Chinese Art
中国艺术精神.author: Xu Fuguan
中国艺术精神.note: How Zhuangzi became the soul of Chinese painting.

二手时间.title: Secondhand Time
二手时间.author: Svetlana Alexievich
二手时间.note: No. 3 on The Guardian's best books of the 21st century. Ordinary voices piece together the end of an empire.

大分流.title: The Great Divergence
大分流.author: Kenneth Pomeranz
大分流.note: Why the industrial revolution happened in England and not in the Yangtze delta.

他乡暖阳.title: The Warmth of Other Suns
他乡暖阳.author: Isabel Wilkerson
他乡暖阳.note: Three lives tell the Great Migration of six million Americans.

枪炮、病菌与钢铁.title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
枪炮、病菌与钢铁.author: Jared Diamond
枪炮、病菌与钢铁.note: Learn how to ask a good big question.

万古江河.title: China: A New Cultural History
万古江河.author: Hsu Cho-yun
万古江河.note: China told as part of the world.

叫魂.title: Soulstealers
叫魂.author: Philip A. Kuhn
叫魂.note: A sorcery scare in 1768 lights up how a whole empire worked.

史记选读.title: Records of the Grand Historian (selections)
史记选读.author: Sima Qian
史记选读.note: Start with the Basic Annals of Xiang Yu, the Biographies of the Assassins and the Letter to Ren An.

魔鬼出没的世界.title: The Demon-Haunted World
魔鬼出没的世界.author: Carl Sagan
魔鬼出没的世界.note: Not scientific knowledge but the scientific spirit: still asking for evidence when faced with authority and a seductive story.

科学革命的结构.title: The Structure of Scientific Revolutions
科学革命的结构.author: Thomas S. Kuhn
科学革命的结构.note: Where "paradigm shift" comes from. How knowledge actually advances.

思考，快与慢.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
思考，快与慢.author: Daniel Kahneman
思考，快与慢.note: Meet the two systems in your own head.

哥德尔、艾舍尔、巴赫.title: Gödel, Escher, Bach
哥德尔、艾舍尔、巴赫.author: Douglas Hofstadter
哥德尔、艾舍尔、巴赫.note: Consciousness, self-reference and intelligence. Getting through it is itself the ultimate deep dive against brain fog.

自私的基因.title: The Selfish Gene
自私的基因.author: Richard Dawkins
自私的基因.note: Change the unit you look from, and the whole world rearranges itself.

笛卡尔的错误.title: Descartes' Error
笛卡尔的错误.author: Antonio Damasio
笛卡尔的错误.note: Without emotion there is no reason.

时间的秩序七堂极简物理课.title: The Order of Time / Seven Brief Lessons on Physics
时间的秩序七堂极简物理课.author: Carlo Rovelli

物种起源.title: On the Origin of Species
物种起源.author: Charles Darwin
物种起源.note: Watch a great mind argue, carefully, step by step.

寂静的春天.title: Silent Spring
寂静的春天.author: Rachel Carson
寂静的春天.note: How one book changed the world.

象与骑象人.title: The Happiness Hypothesis
象与骑象人.author: Jonathan Haidt
象与骑象人.note: Ten ancient ideas, each tested against modern research.

回忆·梦·思考.title: Memories, Dreams, Reflections
回忆·梦·思考.author: C. G. Jung
回忆·梦·思考.note: Jung's autobiography. How one man made his life an exploration of the unconscious.

精神分析引论.title: Introductory Lectures on Psychoanalysis
精神分析引论.author: Sigmund Freud
精神分析引论.note: Many conclusions have been overturned, but he changed how people talk about themselves. Read the original, not a summary.

我们时代的神经症人格.title: The Neurotic Personality of Our Time
我们时代的神经症人格.author: Karen Horney
我们时代的神经症人格.note: A morbid craving for love, a morbid chase after success. Written in 1937, it reads like today.

个人形成论.title: On Becoming a Person
个人形成论.author: Carl Rogers
个人形成论.note: What it means to become a person. The source of humanistic psychology.

直视骄阳当尼采哭泣.title: Staring at the Sun / When Nietzsche Wept
直视骄阳当尼采哭泣.author: Irvin D. Yalom
直视骄阳当尼采哭泣.note: An existential psychotherapist. The first is about the fear of death; the second is a novel where philosophy and psychology meet.

也许你该找个人聊聊.title: Maybe You Should Talk to Someone
也许你该找个人聊聊.author: Lori Gottlieb
也许你该找个人聊聊.note: A therapist goes to see a therapist. Easy to read, and honest.

被讨厌的勇气.title: The Courage to Be Disliked
被讨厌的勇气.author: Ichiro Kishimi / Fumitake Koga
被讨厌的勇气.note: Adler's "separation of tasks". A light dialogue, but strong medicine for anyone who cares too much what others think.

身体从未忘记.title: The Body Keeps the Score
身体从未忘记.author: Bessel van der Kolk
身体从未忘记.note: How trauma stays in the body. Hugely influential; the evidence for some therapies is disputed, so read with that in mind.

社会性动物.title: The Social Animal
社会性动物.author: Elliot Aronson
社会性动物.note: A classic textbook of social psychology that reads like an essay. The road from Goffman to the lab.

亲密关系.title: Intimate Relationships
亲密关系.author: Rowland S. Miller
亲密关系.note: What research has actually found about love and relationships.

金钱心理学.title: The Psychology of Money
金钱心理学.author: Morgan Housel
金钱心理学.note: "Wealth is the money you don't spend." On enough, luck, compounding and patience.

穷查理宝典.title: Poor Charlie's Almanack
穷查理宝典.author: Charlie Munger
穷查理宝典.note: Mental models from many disciplines, and the talk on the psychology of human misjudgment.

巴菲特致股东的信.title: Berkshire Hathaway Letters to Shareholders
巴菲特致股东的信.author: Warren Buffett
巴菲特致股东的信.note: Fifty years of first-hand thinking, better than any book about Buffett.

聪明的投资者.title: The Intelligent Investor
聪明的投资者.author: Benjamin Graham
聪明的投资者.note: Mr. Market and the margin of safety. Focus on chapters 8 and 20.

漫步华尔街.title: A Random Walk Down Wall Street
漫步华尔街.author: Burton G. Malkiel
漫步华尔街.note: Why most people should buy index funds and go read books.

随机漫步的傻瓜.title: Fooled by Randomness
随机漫步的傻瓜.author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
随机漫步的傻瓜.note: How we mistake luck for skill. The prequel to Antifragile.

纳瓦尔宝典.title: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant
纳瓦尔宝典.author: Eric Jorgenson (ed.)
纳瓦尔宝典.note: Aphorisms on wealth and happiness. Seek wealth, not money or status; leverage and specific knowledge.

最优解人生.title: Die with Zero
最优解人生.author: Bill Perkins
最优解人生.note: The opposing view: money is for buying experiences, and saving too much is its own waste. Read it against The Psychology of Money.

贫穷的本质.title: Poor Economics
贫穷的本质.author: Abhijit V. Banerjee / Esther Duflo
贫穷的本质.note: Field experiments by Nobel-winning economists: why the choices of the poor are rational.

稀缺.title: Scarcity
稀缺.author: Sendhil Mullainathan / Eldar Shafir
稀缺.note: How a lack of money and a lack of time eat the same cognitive bandwidth.

有闲阶级论.title: The Theory of the Leisure Class
有闲阶级论.author: Thorstein Veblen
有闲阶级论.note: Where "conspicuous consumption" comes from. Afterwards it is hard to spend money to save face.

债：5000 年债务史.title: Debt: The First 5,000 Years
债：5000 年债务史.author: David Graeber
债：5000 年债务史.note: An anthropologist rewrites the origins of money. Money is first of all a moral relationship.

新教伦理与资本主义精神.title: The Protestant Ethic and the Spirit of Capitalism
新教伦理与资本主义精神.author: Max Weber
新教伦理与资本主义精神.note: Why modern people treat making money as a calling.

金钱不能买什么.title: What Money Can't Buy
金钱不能买什么.author: Michael J. Sandel
金钱不能买什么.note: When everything has a price, what gets corrupted?

鞋狗.title: Shoe Dog
鞋狗.author: Phil Knight
鞋狗.note: Nike's first eighteen years were nearly bankrupt almost every year. Honest, and well written.

从 0 到 1.title: Zero to One
从 0 到 1.author: Peter Thiel
从 0 到 1.note: "What important truth do very few people agree with you on?" On contrarian thinking and monopoly.

黑客与画家.title: Hackers & Painters
黑客与画家.author: Paul Graham
黑客与画家.note: Essays by a maker. Then read the rest of the essays on his website.

创新者的窘境.title: The Innovator's Dilemma
创新者的窘境.author: Clayton M. Christensen
创新者的窘境.note: Why good companies fail precisely because they do everything right. One of the few business books with a real theory.

创业维艰.title: The Hard Thing About Hard Things
创业维艰.author: Ben Horowitz
创业维艰.note: Not about how to succeed, but about what to do when there are no good options.

卓有成效的管理者.title: The Effective Executive
卓有成效的管理者.author: Peter F. Drucker
卓有成效的管理者.note: How knowledge workers manage themselves. Two hundred pages, no filler.

史蒂夫·乔布斯传.title: Steve Jobs
史蒂夫·乔布斯传.author: Walter Isaacson
史蒂夫·乔布斯传.note: Where technology meets the humanities; and what it costs to be a great creator.

富兰克林自传.title: The Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin
富兰克林自传.author: Benjamin Franklin
富兰克林自传.note: Printer, scientist, founder. The source of the self-made-man genre.

禅与摩托车维修艺术.title: Zen and the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance
禅与摩托车维修艺术.author: Robert M. Pirsig
禅与摩托车维修艺术.note: On Quality: what it really means to do a thing well.

人月神话.title: The Mythical Man-Month
人月神话.author: Frederick P. Brooks Jr.
人月神话.note: Ostensibly about software engineering; really about how a group of people builds something complex together.

智能简史.title: A Brief History of Intelligence
智能简史.author: Max Bennett
智能简史.note: From worms to GPT, the brain made five breakthroughs. Evolution, neuroscience and AI on one timeline.

千脑智能.title: A Thousand Brains
千脑智能.author: Jeff Hawkins
千脑智能.note: Thousands of world models in the neocortex, voting. An engineer's bold account of what understanding is; open to argument.

Other Minds.title: Other Minds
Other Minds.author: Peter Godfrey-Smith
Other Minds.note: The octopus is a mind evolution built down a different road. A philosopher dives in to ask where consciousness comes from.

The Secret of Our Success.title: The Secret of Our Success
The Secret of Our Success.author: Joseph Henrich
The Secret of Our Success.note: Humans are clever not because of single brains but because of culture piled up over generations. A far better-evidenced account of why our species won.

脑与意识.title: Consciousness and the Brain
脑与意识.author: Stanislas Dehaene
脑与意识.note: Consciousness becomes, for the first time, something you can measure in a lab.

Being You.title: Being You
Being You.author: Anil Seth
Being You.note: The brain is a prediction machine; the world you see is a controlled hallucination, and so is the self.

为什么.title: The Book of Why
为什么.author: Judea Pearl
为什么.note: The three rungs of the ladder of causation. See what today's AI is still missing.

人机对齐.title: The Alignment Problem
人机对齐.author: Brian Christian
人机对齐.note: Do machines learn what we say, or what we do? Where the problem of AI safety came from.

我看见的世界.title: The Worlds I See
我看见的世界.author: Fei-Fei Li
我看见的世界.note: An immigrant girl, a dry-cleaning shop, ImageNet. A history of deep learning, and one person's life.

An Immense World.title: An Immense World
An Immense World.author: Ed Yong
An Immense World.note: Every animal lives inside its own world of senses. You come away seeing how narrow human reality is.
